name: Crossed transaction
oneLine: A reply that answers from a different ego state than the one the other person addressed, which stops the exchange until someone shifts.
whatYouDid: You answered Arjun's Child complaint from Adult instead of from the Parent he was pulling for, which broke the loop instead of continuing it.
confusion: People often think crossing a transaction is always bad; the tell is that it is the main therapeutic tool - it is how you get out of a fight, not how you start one.

fromBook.quote: communication is broken off when a crossed transaction occurs

expand.definition: Berne's rule 2: when a crossed transaction occurs, communication is broken off and one or both parties must shift ego states for it to resume.
expand.otherFraming: TA Today frames the same move as taking an "option" (Karpman): you may reply from any ego state, not only the one addressed - crossing is one way to exercise that choice.
expand.tryThisToday: Notice the next time someone's tone pulls for a Parent or Child reply from you, and answer from Adult instead.
